news.title: Blizzard Addressing Missing Shaman Totems Due to Monday's Server Issue in WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard has fixed an issue with missing Shaman totems due to server issues on Monday.
news.details:
Yesterday, at around 1 PM PST time, the WoW servers had issues and needed to come down for emergency maintenance. During this time, players reported some issues, including missing totems on Shamans such as Fire Totem. Blizzard has addressed this and it should be restored now.
We have just deployed a fix for this to all regions. Shamans who lost a totem due to the crash should find it restored to their bag.
Shamans who experienced the disappearance, who are currently in-game, will need to make sure you have bag space, and then logout and back in to receive them.

news.title: Blizzard Adding Gold to Many Quests Near Max Level in WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard is adding gold to most quests above level 48, including ones that never previously rewarded gold at all!
news.details:
Blizzard has now confirmed via a Blue Post that the XP-to-Gold conversion has been removed in WoW: Forever and their reasons for the change. However, they agree that this is a little too negative for Gold income near level 60, so they'll be hotfixing in additional gold rewards to most quests above level 48 with the next 24 hours.
When we evaluated the economy going into WoW: Forever, we made a conscious choice to disable the XP-to-Gold conversion for quests completed at maximum level. This change was originally introduced in 2006 in the weeks leading up the original Burning Crusade launch, and it was intended to provide a boost in gold for players who were wrapping up original WoW content in preparation for the first expansion.
We left that functionality in place in Classic Era in 2019, but we decided that for WoW: Forever, we would remove the XP to Gold conversion, as it created an…

news.title: Dungeon Experience in WoW: Forever is Now 60% of Classic Era - Blizzard Happy with Dungeon Level Speeds
news.description: Blizzard has confirmed that dungeon experience in WoW: Forever is now 60% of Classic era values, and that they feel the adjustment is working well.
news.details: We’ve tracked this very carefully, and the hotfix that we deployed on Sunday, November 8 took dungeon kill XP from 40% of the values in Classic Era to 60% of the values in Classic Era. We have subsequently felt that the adjustment is working well to produce dungeon leveling speeds that fit with the rest of WoW Forever content.

news.title: Vendor Price Changes on WoW: Forever - Iron Grenade Shuffle Dead
news.description: With the weekly reset, many items had their Vendor Prices changed on WoW: Forever, likely targeting Vendor Shuffles.
news.details:
Shuffles are a popular gold-making tactic because they take cheap materials and mass-convert them into more expensive items. This usually results in a profit that can quickly stack up over time if players manage to find one and take advantage of it because this is essentially just adding gold into the economy. This is typically why developers usually fix these quickly.
One of the most notable shuffles in Classic is the Iron Grenades shuffle, which took a Iron Bar, Heavy Blasting Powder and Silk Cloth and turned them into multiple Iron Grenades. When prices on the materials are low enough, you could turn 5 silver of vendor materials into 3 Iron Grenades worth 5 silver each.
Recent hotfixes appear to have changed the vendor prices of various crafted items, including reducing the vendor price of Iron Grenades. However, it wasn't all nerfs, as some items actually had their vendor price…

news.title: Warlock and Hunter Class Tuning Now Live in WoW: Forever
news.description: Some Warlock and Hunter class tuning is now live in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
Last week, Blizzard announced upcoming class tuning that should go be going live today. While not all the changes are in yet, we've found a change to the Enhancement Shaman class weapon and now some additional changes for Hunters and Warlocks.
Hunter
Hunters are getting some mana changes to two of their spells.
Summon Hawk now costs a flat 11% base Mana at all ranks.
Arcane Shot now costs a flat 11% base Mana at all ranks.
Warlocks
Some of the changes from the announced class tuning are here for Warlocks. This likely aims to address the spamming of Wrack even without DoTs.
Soul Siphon now specifically names Corruption, Siphon Life, and Bane of Agony (was other Affliction effects) to increase the effects of Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack.
Wrack now deals less damage per tick, but while channeling, Siphon Life, Corruption and Bane of Agony's tick rate increases by 100%.

news.title: Enhancement Shaman Class Weapon Hotfixed on WoW: Forever
news.description: On the Weekly Reset, the Shaman Class Weapon, Rage of the Storm, has been hotfixed to change the attack speed and stats of the weapon.
news.details:

They announced that Enhancement Shamans would want to collect Strength and Attack Power gear for the upcoming class changes. As part of this change, the Shaman class weapon, which comes from The Tempest's Weapons / The Tempest's Weapons, has been hotfixed to change the attack speed and the stats.

news.title: Secret Hunt in WoW: Forever with the Night Watchman's Torch
news.description: The hunt for secrets is on in WoW: Forever, and to jump in, you'll need to find the Night Watchman's Torch in Duskwood.
news.details:
With the Secret Finders hot on the trail of a secret that starts on Zephras Isle, players looking to help or complete the secret themselves will need to snag a torch that was initially discovered on the Forever beta.
Night Watchman's Torch Guide Dawn Waker Secret Guide
Hidden in Duskwood lies a slain Night Watch Guard. What caused this poor guard's demise is unknown, but more importantly, players will notice that this slain guard has a quest!
This quest is an instant turn-in that rewards players with the Night Watchman's Torch, an item players can use to help light up dark areas around them. This item can currently be used anywhere in the world except for inns and capital cities.
While the torch is only used in one portion of the secret, it sets a precedent - any new content added in Forever could play a role in future (or even current) secrets, so it's worthwhile for players to seek it…
